SIZE ASSESSMENT (operator 116, MODEL_ROUTING 8.2) — growth-project-mobile#352 @ 58b80914feb62101aca2c7b5e8985d32912b80b0
- Lines: 1774 changed (source 1595 / tests 151 / migrations 0 / docs 28; excluded 0); 11 files. Under the 3,000 hard limit.
- Seams (largest areas): `src/entitlements/dunning` 1656, `src/services/__tests__` 84, `src/services/api.ts` 18, `src/constants/support.ts` 15, `src/services/README.md` 1.

AUDIT GPT-6.1 Sol — growth-project-mobile#352 @ 58b80914feb62101aca2c7b5e8985d32912b80b0 — VERDICT: REQUEST CHANGES
A/B/C = 0/1/0

Job: AUD-SOL-L12-117; agent 117; independent T4 money/auth-state audit.

### B-352-1 — The payment-lockout singleton accepts another account's state

`src/services/api.ts:276-280`; `src/entitlements/dunning/dunningLockoutStore.ts:27-54`. Every matching 403 writes the process-global lock without checking the request's owning account/auth generation, and neither the store nor this new interceptor retires it on logout. The existing logout reset list omits this new store, so the previous account's signal/reference can survive until a successful later status read. ([Exact interceptor](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/58b80914feb62101aca2c7b5e8985d32912b80b0/src/services/api.ts#L271-L283), [exact store](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/58b80914feb62101aca2c7b5e8985d32912b80b0/src/entitlements/dunning/dunningLockoutStore.ts#L27-L54), [actual logout boundary/reset list](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/58b80914feb62101aca2c7b5e8985d32912b80b0/src/services/authActions.ts#L408-L440))

**Concrete CI counterexamples:** (1) handle A's lockout, emit the production logout boundary: the singleton remains locked; (2) retire A, switch to B, explicitly clear the singleton, then deliver A's delayed 403 with A's Authorization header: B's singleton becomes locked again and retains A's request reference. Both assertions fail against the actual registered response interceptor/store; current-account LOCKED_DUNNING and unrelated-403 controls pass, as does the existing interceptor suite: **2 failed / 4 passed**. This can put a paid next user behind the lockout and suppress their entitlement sheet, especially while B's status read is offline; resetting alone does not fix the delayed-response case. ([Independent CI probe](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37179751151), [downstream consumer in L2](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/e22acc84b3ee99c94f3ec77793b38ca0c8157241/src/entitlements/EntitlementProvider.tsx#L167-L172))

**Minimal fix rule:** make the lock signal account/auth-generation owned, clear/retire it synchronously at the actual logout/account-transition boundary, stamp originating requests with their generation, and discard retired-generation 403s before any global write. Token refresh within the same account must continue working; do not use raw JWT equality as the account identity. Add failing-before/passing-after tests for logout, A→B, delayed old responses after an explicit reset, and valid same-account refresh. Coordinate the provider's own async retirement fence in #353; this finding belongs to L1's signal/transport, not to the other PR's UI. ([Affected L1 code](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/58b80914feb62101aca2c7b5e8985d32912b80b0/src/entitlements/dunning/dunningLockoutStore.ts), [paired L2](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/353))

### Prior findings, evidence reuse and split fidelity

G09 reuse is limited to this model's [original #322 APPROVE at `23435ec2`](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/322#issuecomment-5964847392): L1's source/test/document blobs are byte-identical to that approved head. The prior B-322-1/2/3/4/5/6/7 closures remain on their previously proven scope: retained partial-payment bank context, same-SetupIntent lost-answer reconciliation, guarded SDK promises, consistent complete quotes, explicit invoice approvals and `in_progress` recovery; C-322-2 remains closed. These do not prove the new account-boundary counterexample. ([Prior closure record](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/322#issuecomment-5964847392), [L1 candidate](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/352))

The complete L1 diff and its consumers were independently read. No source imports a later piece; the transport addition is live, while card-flow exports have no screen caller until L2. The approved original plus main `367e6c48` mechanically merges to tree `8f0a27302988e47a0b375c29465b3b9ad7b7dd01`, exactly the L3 tree at `37ed3d56`; the only changed stack-file blob versus the original is `app.json`'s already-landed OTA/fingerprint/build-number main hunk. Native-flow regressions remain in L3, so the mandated complete-stack landing remains essential. ([L1](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/352), [L2](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/353), [L3](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/354), [approved original](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/322#issuecomment-5964847392))

### CI and release boundary

Exact-head Typecheck/lint/test and both required analyses are SUCCESS; the build job actually executed lint, typecheck and tests. The additional audit-only CI job is deliberately red on the two identity invariants, not a required-check regression or infrastructure flake. ([Executed candidate CI](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37153877906/job/111293139565), [JS/TS analysis](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37153877980/job/111293140023), [actions analysis](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37153877980/job/111293139888), [negative proof](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37179751151))

Hold this stack for closure, dual exact-head verdicts and main-candidate checks; backend #687–#691 must be approved/landed/deployed first. FEATURE_DUNNING_V2 activation and real iOS/Android PaymentSheet, 3DS/redirect and universal-link acceptance are not certified by these transport/SDK doubles. Only audit-only branches were pushed; no PR source, production, settings, flag or paid build was changed. Evidence and probe patches are retained under `ops/aud-117/AUD-SOL-L12-117/`. ([Operator landing instruction](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/352#issuecomment-5975773636), [prior release limits](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/322#issuecomment-5964847392))

AUDIT Claude Opus 5.5 — growth-project-mobile#352 @ 58b80914feb62101aca2c7b5e8985d32912b80b0 — VERDICT: APPROVE
A/B/C = 0/0/6

Lens AUD-OPUS-L12-117 (agent 117), T4 (money, account state, paired with backend dunning #687-#691). Piece L1 of the #322 split, base `main` (367e6c48). Independent of every builder and of the Sol lens.

### Split faithfulness and evidence reuse (G09)
- The stack top #354 @ `37ed3d56` has tree `8f0a2730`. That is byte-identical to the clean merge of #322's dual-approved head `23435ec2` with main `367e6c48` (`git merge-tree`).
- Every file in this piece is byte-identical to its version at `23435ec2` and to its final version at #354. No later piece edits an L1 file.
- The Opus lens approved `23435ec2` ([5964778187](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/322#issuecomment-5964778187)), so that evidence applies. I did not rest on it alone. I read every line of the 11 files at T4, and I audited two kinds of change since that approval:
  - the main merge `1f8981dd..367e6c48` (#305 expo-updates, #326 reference helpers and the Sentry `reference` tag, #327);
  - the paired backend contract at #691 `e0afe678`.
- **Prior Opus findings on #322:** B-322-1, B-322-2, C-322-1 and C-322-2 are still closed at this head. They are covered by `cardUpdateOutcomeCopy` and `bankStepCopy` built from the per-currency totals, `describeDunningError` `RESULT_NOT_CONFIRMED` for a lost confirm or cancel, and processing copy that leads with paid money. C-322-3 is carried on #353.

### Piece boundary
- Compiles alone: the Typecheck, lint, test job is green here.
- Nothing imports a later piece. No migrations. No new dependency (`@stripe/stripe-react-native` 0.64.0 is already in `package.json`, loaded lazily).
- Inert until L2: the only live change is the 403 `LOCKED_DUNNING` interceptor branch in `src/services/api.ts:271-284`, and the backend sends that 403 only with `FEATURE_DUNNING_V2` on. `supportMailto(subject, body)` stays backward compatible.

### Contract check against backend #691 `e0afe678` (read, not approved)
| Item | Result |
|---|---|
| Routes and bodies | Match `client-billing.controller.ts` and `dunning-status.controller.ts` (`idempotency_key` is a UUID v4; `approved_invoices` items `{invoice_id, amount_cents, currency}`) |
| Lockout signal | The global `HttpExceptionFilter` keeps `code`, so `LOCKED_DUNNING` reaches the interceptor |
| Confirm quote | The quote the confirm returns satisfies the strict `normalizePaymentQuote`: `complete: true`, and lines and totals use the same filter (`client-billing.service.ts:1316-1328`, `:1227-1231`) |
| Sentry | Extras carry codes and ids only. No axios config, body or headers are attached (checklist a holds) |

### C (optional)
- **C-352-1: main's reference conventions are not used.** Main #326 (B-326-4) added three helpers: `supportReferenceOf` (falls back to the `X-Request-Id` this app sent), `shortReference` (8 characters), and a searchable Sentry `reference` tag.
  - Where: `updateCard.ts:101-111`, `:241-247`, `:305-311`, `dunningErrorCopy.ts:73-85`, `:140`.
  - Problem: the dunning flows report `request_id` as an extra, which Sentry cannot search, and show the full UUID. A dropped confirm answer (`RESULT_NOT_CONFIRMED`, `dunningErrorCopy.ts:201-211`) shows no reference, even though the backend logged the request id the app sent.
  - **Fix rule:** pass `reference` in every `captureError` context, use `supportReferenceOf`, and show `shortReference`.
- **C-352-2: the piece's behaviour tests live in later pieces.** `dunningApi`, `updateCard` and `dunningErrorCopy` are proven by `dunningLockout.test.tsx` (L2) and `nativeCardUpdate.test.tsx` (L3, 1,119 lines). L1's own CI runs only `api.lockedDunning.test.ts` against the new code.
  - **Fix rule (operator):** land #352 -> #354 as one (rule 11). Never land L1 or L2 without L3.
- **C-352-3: the "wait a minute" next step can fail.** `RATE_LIMITED` (`dunningErrorCopy.ts:232-238`) says "Wait a minute, then tap Update card again".
  - The backend puts setup-intent and confirm (and checkout sessions) in one `checkout-mint` bucket of 20 calls per hour (`src/throttler/throttler.config.ts:203-206`). `ThrottlerExceptionFilter` sends `Retry-After: 3600`, so waiting a minute often does not work.
  - **Fix rule:** read `Retry-After` and state when to try again. The step-dependent branch at `dunningErrorCopy.ts:389-405` never fires, because the envelope drops `step` (the backend B-628-10 codes carry the phase). Remove that branch or keep it as dead code.
- **C-352-4: the interceptor message is wrong for a dispute lock.** `api.ts:282` says "a payment has not gone through. Update your card to restore access". That is false for a dispute lock (backend B-628-8: a card update does not end it).
  - It is mostly hidden behind the lockout screen, but surfaces with no lockout screen (for example the coach navigator) show `error.message`.
  - **Fix rule:** use neutral copy ("Your plan is paused over a payment. Open the payment screen to see what to do.").
- **C-352-5: dispute facts are dropped from the outcome copy.** `cardUpdateOutcomeCopy` and `cancelOutcomeCopy` build copy only from structured fields (`dunningErrorCopy.ts:479-481`, `:525-561`). The backend's dispute sentences are discarded:
  - `client-billing.service.ts:1424`: "Saving a card does not settle that".
  - `:1645`: "Ending the plan does not settle the payment your bank reversed".
  - `quote.disputes` is parsed (`dunningApi.ts:279-287`) but never shown.

  This is the L1 half of B-353-2. **Fix rule:** add a dispute line when `quote.disputes` is not empty, and keep the server's dispute note after a cancel. If the #353 builder fixes this here, this head moves and needs a new verdict.
- **C-352-6 (outside this diff, shared code):** #342 adds a second theme builder, `src/components/purchase/usePaymentSheetAppearance.ts` (borderRadius 2), and a second lazy SDK loader (`src/lib/packagePayment.ts:416-440`), alongside `paymentSheetAppearance.ts` here (`radius.md` / `radius.sm`). The card-update and purchase sheets would look different.
  - **Fix rule:** whichever of #342 or #352 merges second uses one builder.

### CI at this head
Typecheck, lint, test; Analyze (javascript-typescript); Analyze (actions); CodeQL: all SUCCESS.

Merge state is BEHIND main `7fdb629a` (#315). The stack top merges cleanly with it. #315 edits `src/services/README.md`, which is a file in this piece, so an update-branch is not a byte-identical refresh (rule 12). It needs a short merge-only delta verdict.

### Release
Backend #687-#691 is deployed first and `FEATURE_DUNNING_V2` stays OFF unless the operator decides otherwise. Native PaymentSheet, 3DS and redirect acceptance on devices remain release gates. B-353-1..4 block the stack (rule 11) but not this piece's own code.

No push to a PR branch, no merge, no dispatch outside the CI lane, no production action.

FIX ROUND 1 (B-LOCK-118, agent 118) — growth-project-mobile#352 @ ac244d22e107e93209a5e1d206d2951d3392fe38

Main merged first (merge commit `fe2fa580`, main `7fdb629a`, clean; #315 touched `src/services/README.md`, unchanged by this round). Then one fix commit `ac244d22`. Size: +2335 / -6 = 2,341 changed lines vs main (1,500-3,000 band: operator SIZE ASSESSMENT needed). Flag stays off; nothing here is used by a screen until #353.

| Finding | Change | Commit | Test (fails before -> passes after) |
|---|---|---|---|

Same-account token refresh keeps the generation. | ac244d22 | `api.lockedDunning.test.ts` "B-352-1" block (4), `authActions.signOut.test.ts` "retires the payment lockout" |

Production's `{ error: 'Not Found' }` 404 for the missing card/cancel routes now reads BILLING_ROUTE_NOT_AVAILABLE ("not available yet, so nothing was charged", not reported) instead of UNKNOWN + Sentry; a bare 503 reason phrase on confirm reads RESULT_NOT_CONFIRMED, never "nothing changed". | ac244d22 | `dunningL1Contract.test.ts` "today's production backend" (3) |

Saving a card does not settle that." and a dispute-only save says "There was no open invoice to pay, so nothing was charged."; `cancelOutcomeCopy(r, { dispute })` keeps the backend limitation. | ac244d22 | `dunningL1Contract.test.ts` "dispute facts" (4) |
| B-353-2 (Sol) port | `runNativeCardUpdate` / `confirmWithBank` take `isCurrent`; new `retired` result; checked before and after every request and native step (setup, init, present, each confirm attempt, handleNextAction). Retirement claims nothing about requests already sent. | ac244d22 | `dunningL1Contract.test.ts` "retired screen" (3 + CONTROL) |

Failing-before (tests only on `fe2fa580`): https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37220096264 (17 failed, 10 passed: every finding test fails, controls pass). After, at ac244d22 + Sol probe: https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37220787955 (27/27 pass).

Probe replay (both lenses, at ac244d22):
| Probe | Before (lens run) | Now |
|---|---|---|
| Sol `auditSol117DunningIdentity.test.ts` CONTROL current-account 403 sets signal | pass | pass |

Money list:
- Webhook order and redelivery: mobile handles no webhooks; lock state comes only from the server status read or a current-generation 403; confirm re-asks reuse the same SetupIntent and approval (backend idempotent).
- Concurrency: requests stamped per auth generation; a retired generation never writes; the native flow stops at every checkpoint once its owner is retired. No client-side locks, so no lock order.
- Terminal states: disputed: copy never promises a card fix and ending the plan says it does not settle the reversal; canceled (2A) and voluntary (option A) copy unchanged; deleted account / sign-out retire the signal.
- List completeness: quote normalizer still fails closed (complete, consistent totals); confirm dispute flags are never dropped, even from incomplete plan entries.
- Currency: integer minor units from the server; disputed amounts summed per currency only, never across currencies.
- Copy truth: no lock the server did not decide; route-absent copy is true on today's production (nothing was sent to the payment provider); no first person, no exclamation marks.

Checks at ac244d22: Typecheck, lint, test pass (https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37220131133); CodeQL pass.

READY FOR AUDIT

AUDIT GPT-6.1 Sol — growth-project-mobile#352 @ ac244d22e107e93209a5e1d206d2951d3392fe38 — VERDICT: REQUEST CHANGES
A/B/C = 0/2/2

Job AUD-SOL-L12-119, agent 119; independent T4 money/auth-state review.

### Prior Sol disposition first

**B-352-1 closed on its original signal/transport scope:** requests now carry the starting auth generation; logout/reset retires the singleton and reference; retired 403s are discarded; same-account token refresh still works. The original four Sol probes and candidate ownership/reset tests all pass in the independent replay, with the builder's actual failing-before evidence also checked. This does not certify every native continuation. ([Prior finding](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/352#issuecomment-5976926738), [builder failing-before](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37220096264), [independent replay and new probes](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37229539410))

### B-352-2 — Disputed-plan outcome copy still implies automatic access recovery

`src/entitlements/dunning/dunningErrorCopy.ts:456-459,477-486,499-504,528-531`. A normalized mixed paid/disputed response (`outcome: paid`, `access_state: partial`, one `plans[].dispute_open: true`) says “Your plan updates within a few minutes” before the dispute limitation; dispute-only saved copy omits that access has ended, billing is paused, and the coach decides whether to restart. These are the L1-owned receipt/recovery helpers, not L2's separate banner/intro finding. ([Candidate L1](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/352), [executed copy counterexamples](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37229539410))

Under binding R-DISPUTE-PAUSE, any charge dispute on a recurring plan ends that plan's access immediately and pauses all its billing, even without a failed renewal; closing the dispute cannot automatically restore it. **Fix rule:** retain the confirmed paid amount for ordinary plans, but scope access recovery to those plans and explicitly state for every disputed/paused plan: access has ended, billing is paused, and the coach decides on restarting. No universal few-minutes restoration/future-charge promise for the disputed plan; preserve mixed currencies and the support path. Add dispute-only and mixed paid/processing/partial tests; align persistent pause metadata with the paired backend rather than treating `dispute_open` as a permanent hold's lifetime. The current candidate tests affirm the old limitation but do not prove this new ruling. ([Candidate helper and tests](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/352), [independent negative controls](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37229539410))

### B-352-3 — A retired native initialization can replace the next account's sheet

`src/entitlements/dunning/updateCard.ts:180-198`. Inside one `guarded` closure, `await sdk.initStripe(...)` is immediately followed by `sdk.initPaymentSheet(...)`; the ownership predicate is checked only after both calls. Hold A's `initStripe`, retire A, then initialize B's sheet; releasing A still initializes the module-owned sheet with A's customer, ephemeral key and SetupIntent before returning `retired`. This is a new native-state write after retirement, not a claim that an already-sent server request was canceled. ([Candidate helper](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/352), [retired-init assertion proof](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37229539410), [shared native SDK implementation](https://github.com/stripe/stripe-react-native))

The independent two-owner SDK-state probe models the installed 0.64.0 native module's single PaymentSheet: B initializes its customer while A's initialization is held; A then replaces it, so B's subsequent presentation observes A rather than B. This is boundary evidence with a SDK double, not a claimed real-device charge or server authorization bypass. **Fix rule:** re-check the initiating owner after `initStripe` and before `initPaymentSheet`, retain ownership checks around every native await, and ensure a retired/in-flight native initializer cannot corrupt a current owner's shared SDK state. Regress this two-owner order plus positive same-owner presentation; do not remove native card update/3DS/1A functionality. ([Two-owner probe](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37229652332), [Stripe native SDK](https://github.com/stripe/stripe-react-native))

### Follow-ups (C; freeze, ticket separately)

- **C-352-1:** `dunningErrorCopy.ts:75-86,155-156`; `updateCard.ts:119-125,269-275`: support references use the raw/full or freshly generated id and `request_id` extra instead of the existing `supportReferenceOf` / `shortReference` / Sentry `reference` tag convention. Rule: one correlation helper and the same full diagnostic reference in the searchable tag and short customer copy. This agrees with the builder's carried C, not a new A/B. ([L1 candidate](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/352), [builder carry-over](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/352#issuecomment-5982675004))
- **C-352-3:** `dunningErrorCopy.ts:247-253`: 429 always says “Wait a minute” even when `Retry-After` is longer. Rule: parse/validate the header and name the actual wait, with a safe fallback. ([L1 candidate](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/352), [builder carry-over](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/352#issuecomment-5982675004))

### Evidence reuse, CI, and operator default

The complete L1 diff and auth/reset/API/support/native consumers were independently read; there is no blanket inherited approval. Original #322 B-322-1..7 closures are retained only on their unchanged reviewed scope; every changed runtime line since that Sol approval was audited afresh, including the new native ownership port and dispute normalizers/copy. L1 imports no later piece; the screen caller and full original native-flow suite arrive in L2/L3, so land #352→#354 as one complete unit. Size 2,341 is within the grandfathered 3,000 ceiling, not a new-PR size failure. ([Original Sol evidence](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/322#issuecomment-5964847392), [L1 fix round](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/352#issuecomment-5982675004), [L2](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/353), [L3](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/354))

Exact-head Typecheck/lint/test and both required analyses passed; independent audit-only CI is deliberately red on the new counterexamples, not a candidate-check regression or infrastructure flake. Initial probe: **3 failed / 28 passed**; final two-owner run: **4 failed / 28 passed**, including the concrete B presentation observing `cus_A` rather than `cus_B` (all prior Sol identity probes and candidate tests pass in both). The legacy-production 404 fallback and flag-off behavior remain truthful on their tested scope. ([Candidate build/test](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37220131133), [candidate analyses](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37220131026), [initial probe](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37229539410), [two-owner probe](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37229652332))

**Default:** hold for these two Bs, preserve functionality, replay both lenses' probes, restack, and obtain fresh dual verdicts. Backend dunning must be approved/landed/deployed before the complete mobile stack; keep the flag off and main-target checks, native iOS/Android PaymentSheet/3DS/redirect/universal-link acceptance as separate release gates. ## Findings
**B-352-7: dispute copy contradicts R-DISPUTE-PAUSE.**
- **Where:** `src/entitlements/dunning/dunningErrorCopy.ts:456-460` (`disputeNotSettledLine`, appended to every card-update outcome at `:477-478,531`, and to `saved` at `:496-498`) and `:588-592` (`cancelOutcomeCopy(r, { dispute: true })`).
- **What the copy says:**
  - "Your bank reversed an earlier payment of $150.00. Saving a card does not settle that. Email <support email> to sort it out."
  - The end-plan outcome adds "Ending the plan does not settle the payment your bank reversed. Email <support email> to sort it out."
- **What the ruling requires:** copy about a dispute on a recurring plan says exactly three things: access has ended, billing is paused, the coach decides on restarting. Nothing restores automatically.
- **Why the current copy fails:** it says none of the three. It sends the client to support "to sort it out", which implies that support can settle the dispute and bring access back. Under the ruling only the coach restarts access.
- **Counterexample:** in run 37229725928 these 4 PROBEs fail:
  - the line has no coach-restart rule and contains "sort it out";
  - the line does not say billing is paused or access has ended;
  - the end-plan dispute outcome has the same problem;
  - a dispute-only card save has the same problem.
- **Fix rule:** one shared dispute sentence in L1, used by every dispute surface (L2 imports it):
  - Text: "Your bank reversed a payment of X to <coach>. Your access has ended and billing for this plan is paused. <Coach> decides whether to restart it."
  - Next step: message the coach. Support only for questions, never as the way to restore access.
  - No "sort it out", no "settle", no restore wording.
- **Verify:** the probe spec above (4 PROBE) plus the builder's own failing-before test.
